rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Hierarchy gap between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Premium Enterprise)
rules: Do not use generic teal for dashboards.
Use #060F1E for the background to reduce eye strain, not pure black.
Cards must be a slightly lighter blue (#0F1A2E).
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards.

surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' style for data-heavy sections (border-r border-b border-white/10).
Use 'Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#060F1E]/70 border-b border-white/10) for sticky headers and nav overlays.
Cards should have a flat background (#0F1A2E), 1px subtle border, max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg).
shadows: Minimal shadow use in dark mode. Rely on borders and surface color steps to create depth.
Use subtle drop-shadows only for glowing accents or floating action buttons.

strategy: Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized to match the Dark Blue Enterprise theme.
Buttons: Pill-shaped or max 8px radius, blue background (#1D4ED8) with smooth hover/active scale animations.
Inputs: Dark surface (#060F1E or #0F1A2E) with white/10 border, focus ring in sky blue (#38BDF8).
Tables: High density, border-collapse, subtle borders.
Charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts) with sky blue and royal blue strokes. Subtle translucent fills.

grids_and_layouts.mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)
rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Mobile-first responsive always. Padding must scale: p-4 to p-6/p-8 on desktop.
Containers with borders must have internal padding to prevent text collision.
All interactive elements need micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use specific transitions, NEVER 'transition: all'. Example: 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease'.
Buttons must have a hover and active state (e.g., active:scale-95).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text.
Explicitly set hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-blue-800 hover:text-white).
Never use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdown overlays.

media.icons: lucide-react (Use crisp, legible stroke icons, preferably sky blue or white). Do not use emoji characters.
images: Images should never exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d_libraries_and_creative.strategy: Minimalist usage for dashboards. Use TSParticles for a subtle constellation or geometric mesh network effect ONLY on the login/authentication screen to convey a 'premium tech' feel. Do not use 3D on data-heavy internal dashboard screens to maintain clarity.

login_background.description: Dynamic 3D geometric shapes creating a modern abstract design set against a deep blue backdrop.

student_leader_1.description: Professional student portrait (woman in blue shirt).

student_leader_3.description: Student in graduation gown for certificate module.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React (.js files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Implement the Dark Blue theme precisely using the colors defined in the palette. Do not invent new colors.
Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Outfit' for headings, not standard sans-serif.
Implement a high-density, card-based layout with subtle 1px borders and max 8px rounded corners.
Create the 3 distinct attendance sessions (Break 1, Break 2, Assembly) as Tabs or distinct views within the Duty Attendance module.
For the Announcement board, ensure read/unread status is clearly visible with typography weight or subtle indicator dots.
All test IDs must be kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='leader-row-approve-button').
DO NOT use raw HTML components for complex interactions (use Shadcn Select, Dialog, Calendar).
Create a clean, enterprise-grade navigation sidebar. Avoid hamburger menus on desktop viewports.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and surface color stepping.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use only the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder URLs.
Use 'sonner' for toasts located in '/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js' or similar.
Examine existing components to understand patterns before creating new ones.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometrical alignment.
